name: Chat + Workspace
description: A conversational interface paired with a persistent working area where AI-generated documents, code, visual outputs, or other artifacts can be viewed and refined without leaving the conversation.

name: Chat + Canvas
description: A conversational prompt surface connected to a visual canvas or preview area where users can inspect, select, and iteratively modify generated interfaces or content.

name: Agent Workflow
description: An interface that exposes an autonomous agent's plan, tool use, intermediate steps, execution state, and results as a traceable multi-step workflow.

name: Multi Panel IDE
description: An AI-native development environment that coordinates chat, code editing, file navigation, terminal output, diffs, previews, and agent activity across multiple persistent panels.

name: Visual Workflow Builder
description: A node-based or block-based canvas for assembling AI models, tools, data sources, conditions, and actions into an inspectable executable workflow.

name: Prompt → App
description: A product flow that transforms a natural-language request into a runnable application, then supports iterative refinement through prompts, visual previews, or direct code changes.

name: AI Research Workspace
description: A research-oriented interface that combines conversational querying, web or document retrieval, citations, source inspection, synthesis, and saved research context in one workspace.
